title: fix(plugin-auth): identity objects keep the single posture's Default Organization (ADR-0131 D3)
body:
Fixes #23189
Clause-②: no — it restores a declared invariant: ADR-0131's "Default Organization bootstrap (made load-bearing by D3)", which `default-organization-invariant.ts` states as "[ADR-0131 D3] The Default Organization as a BOOT INVARIANT under the single posture". The `start()` it adds implements the `Plugin` interface's existing lifecycle member; no published schema or export moves.

## What changed

- **`@objectstack/plugin-auth`:** `IdentityObjectsPlugin` gains a `start()`. Under `single` it calls `ensureDefaultOrganizationExists` on the `objectql` engine, the same call `AuthPlugin.start()` makes, and a failure fails the boot. The posture comes from the `tenancy` service when one is registered, otherwise from `resolveTenancyPosture()`. That is the same check `AppPlugin` uses to decide whether to load its inline seed. As triage directed, the invariant is not exported for hosts to call. The `init()` refusal of the composition with `AuthPlugin` is unchanged.
- **`@objectstack/runtime`:** `AppPlugin.optionalDependencies` gains `com.objectstack.auth.identity-objects`, next to `com.objectstack.auth`. Without this edge the fix works only when a host lists the plugins in the right order (measured below).
- **Consumer rigs (test-only, `@objectstack/service-automation`):** two integration rigs mount `createIdentityObjectsPlugin()` and registered their SQLite driver after `bootstrap()`. Once `start()` reads `sys_organization`, that boot fails (`No driver available for object 'sys_organization'`). Both rigs now publish the driver as a `driver.default` service before the boot. `runas-system-stamping` used to insert its own `org_1` (slug `default`) in place of the missing organization. It now reads the Default Organization the boot created and uses that as the member's organization.
- **Changeset:** `.changeset/23189-identity-objects-default-organization.md`, a patch for both packages. It tells kit authors to publish the driver before the boot and to drop a hand-inserted organization row.

## PM hypotheses, measured

- **H1 holds.** At `d4aaeaf0e2`, `identity-objects-plugin.ts` had `init()` and no `start()`. `ensureDefaultOrganizationExists` is exported from `default-organization-invariant.ts:70` but not from the barrel. `AuthPlugin.start()` calls it under `single` (`auth-plugin.ts:752`-`:760`).
- **H2 holds.** On a real kernel, `AuthPlugin` plus `createIdentityObjectsPlugin()` is refused at `init()` (new pin), so a kernel with both mounted never reaches either `start()`. Triage's pin "both mounted gives one Default Organization" therefore becomes two pins: the existing refusal still holds, and the invariant is idempotent (a second `start()` over the same store keeps one organization). The refusal was not lifted.
- **H3 holds.** The built `.d.ts` of `@objectstack/plugin-auth`, diffed against `d4aaeaf0e2`'s build (turbo cache restore), adds only the `start(ctx: PluginContext)` member (returning a void Promise) on `IdentityObjectsPlugin`, plus doc comments. `index.d.ts` and `index.d.mts` show the same diff, and `rate-limit-storage.d.ts` is byte-identical. There is no new export, option or type, so Clause-② stays `no`.
- **H4: one input only `AuthPlugin` holds.** `AuthPlugin.start()` reads the posture from `this.tenancy.posture`, the `tenancy` service that only `AuthPlugin.init()` registers. Without `AuthPlugin`, the plugin reads a host-registered `tenancy` service when there is one (in-repo, `standalone-stack-seeder-declaration-copy.test.ts` registers one), otherwise the requested posture. The engine comes from `ctx.getService('objectql')`, which is this plugin's hard dependency. No `AuthPlugin` internals are imported, and `default-organization-invariant.ts` is imported but not edited.

## Found while measuring: start order, and why `AppPlugin` changes

The existing full-kernel pin (`default-organization-boot-invariant.pin.test.ts`) registers `AppPlugin` before `AuthPlugin` on purpose: the kernel must start the auth plugin first because `AppPlugin` declares it, not because of where a host listed it. The reduced kernel needs the same edge. I measured the new runtime pin with `AppPlugin` registered before `createIdentityObjectsPlugin()` and without the edge (commit `5373c9776b`, before `e21f23a75b`): the Default Organization was created, but after `AppPlugin.start()` had already loaded the seed, so both tenant-scoped seed rows were refused:

```text
× holds exactly the Default Organization, written before the first seed row
  AssertionError: expected -1 to be greater than or equal to 0      (no seed row was ever inserted)
× every seed row of the tenant-scoped object carries it; ...
  AssertionError: expected [] to deeply equal [ 'org_mv6d7bxw435shkzo', …(1) ]
Tests  2 failed | 2 passed (4)
```

With the edge, the same file is 4/4 green. `AppPlugin`'s docblock premise ("a composition without the auth plugin registers no organization object") has been false since `IdentityObjectsPlugin` started registering `sys_organization`, and the docblock now says so. The edge is a mechanical copy of the existing `com.objectstack.auth` entry (ADR-0116 order-if-present), so it adds no cycle: `IdentityObjectsPlugin` depends only on the engine and, optionally, on `com.objectstack.auth`.

## Pins

- `packages/plugins/plugin-auth/src/identity-objects-plugin.test.ts`, describe 5, real kernel (SQLite):
  - under `single` without `AuthPlugin`, a system-context insert on a tenant-scoped app object lands stamped with the Default Organization, which is the only organization;
  - calling `start()` a second time over the same store creates no second organization;
  - under `group` and `isolated`, no organization is created;
  - a host-registered `tenancy` service overrides the requested posture, in both directions;
  - `AuthPlugin` plus the identity objects is still refused at `init()`.
- `packages/runtime/src/identity-objects-default-organization.pin.test.ts` composes ObjectQL, sqlite-wasm, a real `AppPlugin` with seed datasets (registered before the identity objects), `createIdentityObjectsPlugin()` and `SecurityPlugin`:
  - the Default Organization is written before the first seed row;
  - every seed row of the tenant-scoped object carries it;
  - the `tenancy: { enabled: false }` control carries none;
  - a system insert is stamped;
  - under `isolated`, no organization is created and `AppPlugin` leaves its seed to the per-organization replay.

## Negative-pin ablation (`start()` skips the invariant)

Script with a `trap` restore. Fix committed first (HEAD `e5f392da4e`). Mutations made through `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs`:

1. In `identity-objects-plugin.ts`, the `if (postureInForce(ctx) !== 'single') return;` guard became always-true: anchor 1 to 0, blob `e71cadbc` to `2ad581ec`.
2. Harness only: the runtime pin's kernel logger went from `silent` to `warn`, so the seed loader's refusal prints (blob `c921f402` to `99eb2c68`).

`@objectstack/plugin-auth` was rebuilt, and `ablation-dist-preflight` confirmed the marker reached `dist/` (exit 0).

```text
plugin-auth pin:  Tests  3 failed | 12 passed (15)
  × under single, without AuthPlugin: a system insert on a tenant-scoped object is stamped with the Default Organization
  SystemWriteOrganizationRequiredError: Insert on 'kit_account' was REFUSED: a system-context write on a tenant-scoped
  object must carry an organization, and this install declares the 'single' tenancy posture but holds NO organization,
  so there is no Default Organization to derive the owner from. ...
runtime pin:      Tests  3 failed | 1 passed (4)
  ERROR [SeedLoader] Seed record #0 of 'pin_kit_ledger' was REFUSED: 'pin_kit_ledger' carries an organization_id column,
  this seed load names no organization (config.organizationId) and none can be derived — the install holds no
  organization at all. ...
```

The walled-posture pins stay green under the ablation, as expected: they assert that no organization is created. Restore went through `git checkout HEAD --` on absolute paths. `git diff HEAD` shows 0 lines, and both blobs match HEAD (`e71cadbc…`, `c921f402…`). After a rebuild, the preflight `--absent` check exits 0, and both pins are green again (15/15 and 4/4).

## Tests run (HEAD `67f99e580f`, `origin/main` `8323cad97e` merged in)

- `@objectstack/plugin-auth`: `pnpm test` 136 files / 2786 passed / 10 skipped; `pnpm typecheck` exit 0.
- `@objectstack/runtime`: `pnpm test` (project `local`) 365 files / 5182 passed / 19 skipped; `pnpm typecheck` exit 0.
- `@objectstack/service-automation`: `pnpm test` 189 files / 2496 passed; `pnpm typecheck` exit 0.
- Gates: 66 commands from `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands` (derived from git with no paths, at HEAD `67f99e580f`), plus 9 more. Six of those are roster families whose roster sits in a directory this diff touches (`check-changeset-fixed`, `auth-mount-ledger`, `authz-resolver`, `error-code-casing`, `filter-alias-parity`, `route-ledger-census`). The other three are `init-service-contract`, `startup-registry-verdict` and `durability-log-level`. All 75 exit 0. On the first pass `pnpm check:dual-build-cjs-loads` exited 3 with `PREREQUISITE NOT MET`: about 38 packages outside this diff had no `dist/`. That was NOT MEASURED, not a failure. I re-ran it after a full workspace build (`turbo run build`, 74 tasks, 73 from cache) and it exited 0: 108 `require` entry points across 67 packages load. `dispatch-gates --ran` reports: 66 derived, 66 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED, 0 UNRUN.

## Acceptance notes

- The header of `default-organization-invariant.ts` still says "Its one caller is `AuthPlugin`", which is no longer true. The claim declared that file read-only for this card, so I did not edit it. Whoever next touches the file should update that sentence (no one is assigned).
- Without `AuthPlugin`, three things read the tenancy posture, and they read it differently. `AppPlugin` and this plugin use the `tenancy` service, otherwise the requested posture. `SecurityPlugin` uses the `tenancy` service, otherwise `org-scoping ? 'isolated' : 'single'`, and injects that into the engine. The engine uses its injected provider, otherwise the requested posture. They disagree only when a walled posture is requested in a reduced kernel without `org-scoping`. In that case no Default Organization is created and system writes are refused, either for having no organization or because of the wall. The refusal is loud, not silent. This is an observation, not something to file. Owner: none.
- Kits outside this repository that mount `createIdentityObjectsPlugin()` and register their driver after `bootstrap()` will now fail at boot and name the object. The changeset explains how to fix that. Cloud's boot-smoke reaches its seed through `AppPlugin`, which is the composition the runtime pin covers. After this lands, it still needs a pin bump on cloud's side.
